deduplication: Distinct kind/scope/pattern or typed selector signatures; one unit allocation per complete required-context group. Repeated occurrences do not add units.
veto: Only accepted rule IDs from the unchanged binary matcher contribute. Exclusion-vetoed concepts, failed context groups, locally negated matches and nonmatches score zero.
rationale: One broad lexical match establishes the base rank (0.5). A title-specific or typed-fact match and a complete multi-part context group receive two evidence units (0.75). Additional distinct signatures increase rank with diminishing increments. These are documented ordinal weights, not fitted probabilities or claims of statistical independence.
limitation: Evaluation-only evidence ranking, not calibrated confidence. Binary false negatives generally score zero; curves cannot recover evidence absent from the production rules. No tuning against this reference run.
